description: This file defines API routes for managing, executing, and retrieving information about test runs in a test automation system. It includes endpoints for creating test runs, executing specific test cases, listing runs, and fetching run logs and artifacts. The file integrates with a test framework (Robot Framework), a database via SQLAlchemy, and external storage services, acting as a key component for orchestrating test executions asynchronously.

methods.name: execute_test_run(run_id: int, robot_file_path: str, testcase_name: Optional[str], variables: Optional[dict], include_tags: Optional[str], exclude_tags: Optional[str], timeout: Optional[int])
methods.description: Background function to execute a test run: updates run status, invokes robot executor, saves artifacts, and handles cleanup.

methods.name: RunResponse create_run( run_create: RunCreate, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to start a new test run for an entire robot test file, handling file retrieval, temp storage, and background execution.

methods.name: RunResponse run_testcase( request: RunTestCaseRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to execute a specific test case from a test file, managing dependencies and background task scheduling.

methods.name: List[RunResponse] list_runs( skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, status_filter: Optional[RunStatus] = None, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a list of all test runs with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: RunResponse get_run( run_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve details of a specific test run by ID.

methods.name: RunLogsResponse get_run_logs( run_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch logs and report artifacts URLs and contents for a completed run.

methods.name: List[RunResponse] queue_batch_execution( request: RunQueueExecuteRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: API endpoint to queue multiple test files or test cases for execution as a batch process.
